prompt: Ink and watercolor illustration in the style of a fantasy cartographer's sketchbook: thick uneven black India-ink outlines with a dip-pen look, loose wet-in-wet indigo and deep teal washes, granulating pigment, a few warm ochre touches for distant lights, visible paper grain, wide cinematic panoramic landscape at night.
